ValidationRule.description: 10081 : Update Forecast Billing Line Validation Rule to When Moving from Stage 4 to Stage 5. Restrict users to move from stage 4 to stage 5 if each related Sales Billing Forecast record's sales billing estimate is < 1.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.Disable_VR__c && OR(ISBLANK($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c), CONTAINS($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c, 'Opportunity'))), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '5 - Signed/PO in'), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Type , 'Renewal')|| ISPICKVAL( Type , 'Framework')), Amount / CURRENCYRATE(TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode)) >= 25000, OR(Min_Of_Sales_Billing_Estimate__c < 1, ISBLANK(Min_Of_Sales_Billing_Estimate__c)), AND( $Profile.Name <> 'IM_Custom Sys Admin', $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'IM_Sales_IMTN' ), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please update all Sales Billing Estimates under Sales Billing Forecast.
